title: 7-Days CBG Bills Notice Sept. 26, 24
text:
NOTICE
ISSUE OF 7- DAY CENTRAL BANK BILLS
Tender for 7-day Central Bank Bills amounting to one billion Dalasi (D1,000,000,000) will
be issued and settled today, Thursday Sept 26, 2024. Tender closes at 3.00 p.m.
Given that the Central Bank Bills cannot be settled through the Security Settlement
System yet (due to ongoing upgrade of the CBG Core Banking Application),
completed applications with official signatures and Stamp should be submitted online
at omo@cbg.gm, before 3:00 p.m. today Sept 26, 2024.
Quotes will be accepted up to the current Monetary Policy Rate of 17 percent as
contained in the revised guidelines or until the float size is exhausted. Also note that bills
will be issued at face value.
BANKING DEPARTMENT
CENTRAL BANK OF THE GAMBIA
Sept 26, 2024
NB: Application forms attached
